text: Agile methodology is a popular way of managing projects, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything at the start, teams work in short cycles called sprints, usually lasting two to four weeks. Before each sprint, the team chooses tasks from a prioritised list called the backlog, which is filled with user stories describing what customers need. Every day, team members meet briefly for standups to share progress and discuss problems. This iterative development approach allows teams to review their work regularly, adapt to changes quickly, and deliver useful products to customers step by step.
